d: Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado is back after nearly a year in exile. The Nobel Peace Prize winner fled amid fears of persecution under Nicolás Maduro and travelled to Norway to accept the award. Now, she has returned to a country where Maduro is gone, but his former deputy, Delcy Rodríguez, remains interim president with backing from Donald Trump. Machado wants free elections, but Washington is working with Rodríguez's government on oil deals and a political transition. Will Machado get a real chance to challenge for power?
